newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil lowers posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil lowers posted oil prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said it lowered the price it would pay for some grades of crude oil by C$8.00/cubic metre or C$1.27/barrel, effective immediately.

The new prices were listed as follows: Edmonton light sweet C$194.00/cubic metre, or C$30.84/barrel Cromer light sour C$188.00/cubic metre, or C$29.89/barrel Bow River at Hardisty C$161.00/cubic metre, or C$25.60/barrel Midale at Cromer C$170.00/cubic metre, or C$27.03/barrel -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
